finding.claim: The /logo handler fetches an attacker-supplied URL with the default http.Get client after only checking that the raw string contains 'example.io'. This allows SSRF to internal, loopback, and cloud-metadata endpoints, with the full response body returned to the attacker.
finding.source: main.go:31 - r.FormValue("logo") on the unauthenticated /logo route (registered at main.go:43)
finding.sink: main.go:36 - http.Get(raw) using the default client (follows redirects), response copied to the client at main.go:38

trace.note: Only guard: strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") - substring match on the raw string, not the parsed host
http.Get(raw) parses the string independently; host is whatever the attacker put before/after the substring
io.Copy(w, resp.Body) returns the fetched body to the attacker (full-response SSRF)

finding.guards_checked: Substring check at main.go:32 is bypassed by: http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/?example.io (example.io in query); http://example.io@169.254.169.254/ (example.io as userinfo); http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin#example.io (fragment). No scheme allowlist, no parsed-host allowlist, no private/loopback/link-local IP blocking, no redirect restriction (default client follows up to 10 redirects), no timeout. Verified /cdn (main.go:14-28) is NOT vulnerable: parsed Hostname is checked against exact allowlist at main.go:20, same parsed URL is fetched, and redirects are blocked by noRedirect at main.go:12/24.

verdict.guard_found: none. The only check is the substring test strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") at main.go:32, which does not close the finding. No parsed-hostname allowlist, IP blocking, or redirect restriction exists on the /logo path. The /cdn guards at main.go:20 and main.go:12/24 are on a separate handler and do not apply here.
verdict.reason: The /logo route (main.go:43) has no authentication, reads the attacker-controlled "logo" parameter at main.go:31, passes it to http.Get at main.go:36 after only a raw substring check at main.go:32, and copies the response body back at main.go:38, so the SSRF is confirmed.
